name: Construction Crane
summary: Tall tower crane with a long jib and a swaying hook; room-scale for building-site and skyline scenes.

params.name: y
params.note: floor line: the footing stands on y; at s = 1 the crane is about 960 px tall, so keep y near 1560 or lower s

params.name: s
params.note: room scale: about 960 px tall and 740 px wide at s = 1; use about 0.6 for a smaller scene

params.name: color
params.note: jib, cab and hook block colour

params.name: anim
params.note: sway = the hook and cable swing from the trolley

author: krakujs
